The current branch contains f680c29442 for same-artifact FHIR-30406, which renamed the item-subject search parameter away from the obsolete overlong id.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml defines id QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject, and implementationguide-QuestionnaireResponse-core.xml no longer contains generated resource references. Zulip discussion for FHIR-22489 noted R5 already had a formal item-subject search parameter and framed remaining concern as an R4/R4B technical correction. FHIR-30406, the same generated artifact problem, is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build source is already correct for this issue: the obsolete questionnaireresponse-extensions-QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject id is absent from active source, and the active id is within the FHIR id length constraint.
